title: Tranche 3C: power
description: Designed and planned. 7 tasks. docs/plans/2026-08-31-power-design.md and docs/plans/2026-08-31-power.md. One battery widget per output: level glyph, optional label, warning tone when low and not charging. Battery joins the 3B sampling service as another source; fifteen glyphs extend the 3D icon font at no code cost. Audited 2026-08-31; selector-API rebase (sysc-23) applied. Blocked on sysc-19 and sysc-10. Signatures against sysc-metrics are PROVISIONAL. Task 0 is a mandatory reconciliation gate. See sysc-19 and https://github.com/Nomadcxx/sysc-metrics/issues/1.
